response.sql: WITH per_order AS (SELECT orderslink, AVG(rebtotal) AS avg_reb, AVG(feerate - rebrate) AS avg_net FROM fees GROUP BY orderslink), bench AS (SELECT AVG(feerate - rebrate) AS b FROM fees) SELECT AVG(p.avg_reb) AS avg_of_avg_rebtotal, AVG(p.avg_net) AS avg_of_avg_net_rate, AVG(p.avg_net - bench.b) AS avg_excess_over_benchmark FROM per_order p CROSS JOIN bench WHERE p.avg_net > bench.b

assumptions.assumption: The net fee rate is computed per fee record as feerate - rebrate, so it is NULL when either value is NULL, and those records are skipped in the averages.
Fee records with NULL orderslink form one group, which GROUP BY already produces. That group is compared with the benchmark like any other order.
